findings.area: agenda row icon — Juventus – Napoli (Serie A, Søndag 1. november, 20:45)
findings.issue: Shows a plain blank/empty outlined square where a club crest should be, instead of either a real crest or the app's own generic fallback icon (a filled circle-with-dot) used consistently for teams with no known crest elsewhere on the same board, e.g. CD Pamplona – Eibar, Coruxo – Zamora, Peña Sport – Huesca. Juventus and Napoli are both major clubs whose crests render fine in other contexts for comparable clubs (Genoa, AC Milan, Bologna, Bayern Munich, etc. all show correct crests nearby), so this reads as a broken/failed image load for this specific fixture rather than an intentional 'unknown crest' state.

notes: Captured full-page screenshots at 375/393/900px, then re-captured each width as a sequence of ~900px-tall scroll segments (12 segments at 375px, 9 at 900px) and read those with the Read tool, since the full-page shots compress too much to read fixture text reliably.

Fixture names read in full with no truncation hiding key info at any width, including long ones ('Ciudad De Lucena – Rayo Majadahonda', 'Gimnastica Segoviana – Cultural Leonesa', 'Borussia Mönchengladbach – SC Paderborn 07') and Norwegian entries ('Brann – Molde', 'Start – Lillestrøm', 'Vålerenga – Tromsø', 'Bodø/Glimt – Viking', 'Aalesund – Sandefjord').

Channel column is consistently Norwegian/Nordic and honest: TV 2 Play, Viaplay, Twitch (PGL), HBO Max (Sport); an honest faint '–' shows for the many lower-tier Copa del Rey rows with no known Norwegian stream. No ESPN/FOX/Sky spotted.
Must-see accent dots used sparingly — seen on Eliteserien/Norwegian rows (Bodø/Glimt – Viking) and a couple of marquee matches (Manchester City – Brighton, Barcelona – Alavés), not on every row.
No horizontal scroll or clipped content at any width, including the hardest 375px case. 900px keeps a single centered column well short of the viewport edges, per DESIGN.md.

The floating 'Assistent' button never occludes the last agenda/news row or the footer at any width checked — at the bottom of the page 'Oppdatert 26.10.2026', 'Abonner i kalender', and the AI-budsjett line are fully visible clear of the button; mid-page the button does rest over various agenda rows as scroll position changes, which is the sanctioned iOS 26 floating-button idiom (DESIGN.md § Hjelperen) and not a finding.

Header, weekday headings (Tirsdag/Torsdag/Fredag/Lørdag/Søndag), the 'Neste opp' esports pågår-nå list, 'Dette dekker vi' / 'Merker og kilder' disclosures, and footer all intact and aligned at every width.

One day ('I morgen' / Tirsdag 27. oktober, the Copa del Rey round) lists a very large number of fixtures inline rather than being collapsed — not flagged as a bug since it is a single quiet column (not a grid) and reflects real schedule density, but it is the longest, least 'calm' stretch of the board.
'Dataene er ~4 t gamle — oppdatering kan ha stoppet' freshness notice visible in the footer — informational by design, not a rendering issue.
